metadata.title: Pass 3 reference tables: Schnakenberg reaction-diffusion on curved Dictyostelium geometries (hemispherical mound, elongating stalk) and extracellular phosphodiesterase kinetics (Schnakenberg PDE extension, Martiel-Goldbeter 1987 relay)

sources.citation: Schnakenberg J (1979). Simple chemical reaction systems with limit cycle behaviour. Journal of Theoretical Biology 81(3):389-400.
Martiel J-L, Goldbeter A (1987). A model based on receptor desensitization for cyclic AMP signaling in Dictyostelium cells. Biophysical Journal 52(5):807-828.

Gerisch G, Hess B (1974). Cyclic-AMP-controlled oscillations in suspended Dictyostelium cells: their relation to morphogenetic cell interactions. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences USA 71(5):2118-2122.
Crampin EJ, Gaffney EA, Maini PK (1999). Reaction and diffusion on growing domains: scenarios for robust pattern formation. Bulletin of Mathematical Biology 61(6):1093-1120.

laplace_beltrami_sphere.hemisphere_boundary: no-flux at the equator theta = pi/2 (agar contact line); even reflection gives the full-sphere solution

planar_turing_band_q.formula: roots of d q^2 - gamma (d f_u + g_v) q + gamma^2 det J_0 = 0

critical_mound_radius.meaning: below R_min no spherical harmonic l >= 1 is unstable; the mound stays homogeneous

lean_law4_integer_units.note: Lean q = 10 k^2 / gamma equals l(l+1) when gamma R^2 = 10 (R = sqrt(10/180) = 0.2357)

elongating_stalk.note: 2 pi R_stalk = 0.503 < lambda_min = 0.576, so azimuthal modes lie above the band and the pattern is axisymmetric rings

growth.law: L(t) = L0 exp(rho t), uniform growth with dilution -(L'/L) u (Crampin et al. 1999, uniform-growth formulation)

first_order_extension.ode: du/dtau = a - (1 + kappa) u + u^2 v, dv/dtau = b - u^2 v

michaelis_menten_extension.ode: du/dtau = a - u + u^2 v - k_e u / (K_m + u), dv/dtau = b - u^2 v
michaelis_menten_extension.criticality: supercritical (limit-cycle amplitude grows continuously from zero at k_e^Hopf)

martiel_goldbeter_1987.units: rate constants in min^-1; k_e = extracellular phosphodiesterase degradation rate

experimental_period_reference_min.source: gerisch1974 (spontaneous cAMP oscillations in suspended D. discoideum cells)
